title: Paul McCartney live: Staples Center, Los Angeles | 2002
content:
Paul McCartney performed at the Staples Center in Los Angeles, California, USA, on 28 October 2002.

It was the 49th date of the Driving World Tour, which lasted for 58 dates across four countries between April and November 2002. This show was seen by 15,866 fans.

McCartney’s band was Paul ‘Wix’ Wickens (vocals, keyboards, guitar, percussion, harmonica), Brian Ray (vocals, guitar, bass), Rusty Anderson (vocals, guitar), and Abe Laboriel Jr (vocals, drums).

The Driving World Tour previously called at the Staples Center on 4 May 2002. McCartney also performed there on 29 and 30 November 2005 during the US Tour, as well as at several Grammy Awards ceremonies.
